method: CUA actions and visible DOM in a separate localhost:5177 origin. Normal shops, paid purchases and XP, first three PvE rounds and reward choices; no application-state or local-storage injection. A local UI smoke session, not a full campaign, human-win-rate or real-touch performance result.
actionsObserved: Bought gunner, guard and pangolin for three gold in R1; recommendation deployed three; reload restored 100HP/7gold/level3.
Completed R1/R2/R3 PvE through normal start, automatic settlement and reward continuation.
Equipped alloy blade on gunner in R2; bought two normal duplicate cards and one paid XP action in R3.
R3 recommendation retained one equipped blade and one inventory crystal; R4 retained the blade plus crystal and life-core in inventory.
R4 recommendation named Zero Machine; opening scout showed its actual current four-unit deployment and the warning about AI adjustment before battle.
390px recommendation, armory/intel links; 320px recommendation and reload restored 100HP/17gold/level4, 4/8XP, four deployed and one reserve.
Long codex close was above scrollport before fix. Fixed header/scroll body retained a visible 44px close after 619px codex and 1480px help scroll; both closed through the actual button.
Current treant image loaded; expanded handbook had 22 traits including insect 2/4, infantry armor reduction 3/9/18, vanguard armor 6/14. Browser viewport override reset.
limitations: Natural task completion was fast; cancellation, stale results and error/retry race conditions were verified by module tests, not artificially slowed browser jobs.
Current insect descriptions were checked; migration/reconciliation of an actual held old-save pair was not newly exercised in this UI session.
No complete 30-round current-version UI campaign, real touch hardware or low-end device benchmark in this session.
Desktop and recommendation screenshots predate the isolated manual-dialog wrapper fix; the saved codex-after screenshot and final resource/log evidence follow that fix.
